name: forgot-password
title: Forgot password
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Ask for a reset link. The confirmation does not reveal whether the address has an account.

files.content:
/**
 * Clean-room copy for password recovery and email verification.
 * One sentence per outcome. Nothing here takes an "account exists" flag.
 */

export type AuthLocale = "es-MX" | "en"

const LEAK =
  /no account|not found|does not exist|doesn't exist|no existe|sin cuenta|no encontramos|unknown user|user not found|correo no registrado|email not registered/i

export function recoveryCopyLeaksAccount(text: string) {
  return LEAK.test(text)
}

export function recoverySentBody(locale: AuthLocale) {

}

export function forgotCopy(locale: AuthLocale) {

docs: Clean-room. shadcn/studio forgot-password (Free and Pro) was not copied: the Free tier adds the Commons Clause, which blocks redistribution in a component library, and Pro was not purchased. No source, sample data, icons, or strings were copied. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. The sent sentence is identical whether or not the address has an account (proposed hub rule RUI-AUTH-ENUM-001).
